name: elysium-mainnet-gloam
rpcUrl: FILL IN: Elysium mainnet RPC that answers eth_getLogs
poseidon: FILL IN: the Poseidon Gloam's vault uses (its poseidon2())
factory: FILL IN: Cloak's v4 launch factory on mainnet
whype: FILL IN: Cloak's own fixed WHYPE on mainnet (not the upgradeable 0xbA87...5E81)
feeRecipient: FILL IN: the relay's fee account (the launch vault's 0.5% pays relay gas)

ecosystem._note: Outside tokens (CloakEcosystemVault). Fixed at deploy: a token needs the Safe's proposal, a plain native-HYPE v4 pool (no hook) with at least minHypeLiquidity HYPE in range, a market cap of at least minMcapHype HYPE, caps at most maxPerDepositBps / maxTotalBps of its supply, and admitDelaySecs before admit() checks it all again.

tokens._token: KNTQ's HyperEVM address from Kinetiq's docs (kinetiq.xyz/docs/contracts-and-audits). CHECK it is KNTQ on Elysium too before deploying: the script skips a token with no code there.
tokens._pool: FILL IN: the fee and tick spacing of KNTQ's native-HYPE v4 pool with no hook on Elysium. If KNTQ trades only on another DEX, it can't be admitted until such a pool exists (the router trades v4 pools only).
